Name: Kenneth's Chilly Treats
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Adds 32 custom chilly treats to Kenneth's Dessert Shop - blue raspberry ice pop, lime green popsicle, grape purple popsicle, rainbow fruit popsicle, red berry sorbet cone, fudge popsicle bar, blue bubblegum ice cream cone, kiwi blueberry popsicle, chocolate ice cream sandwich, chocolate banana popsicle, blue lagoon popsicle, watermelon layer popsicle, red strawberry ice pop, twin cherry popsicles, green apple popsicle, honeydew melon popsicle, watermelon slice popsicle, round vanilla ice cream sandwich, neapolitan ice pop, chocolate fudge ice cream cone, pistachio scoop cone, chocolate chip ice cream cookie, strawberry scoop cone, mint chocolate chip popsicle, clown face ice cream cone, waffle cone with chocolate drizzle, sprinkle chocolate cone, vanilla cherry scoop cone, strawberry sundae with cherry, orange creamsicle cone, chocolate sundae with cherry, and mint sundae with cherry - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requires Kenneth's Dessert Shop - this mod's items are sold across its 3 shops.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Customization: By default, all chilly treats appear in Kenneth's Dessert Shop. If you want to customize your selection and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual chilly treats to remove them from the shop along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling a chilly treat restores it to the shop and its recipe to your kitchen.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]More details can be found in ReadMe.txt.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Please do not reupload this mod or include it in modpacks without permission.[/b][/size]
